name: ibmi-mcp
description: Give your AI agent terminal and file transfer access to IBM i systems
long_description: ibmi-mcp lets AI agents like Claude interact with IBM i the same way a human would through a 5250 green-screen terminal. It provides full TN5250 emulation with auto-signon, function key support, local editing, structured screen data, and configurable EBCDIC codepage translation. It also supports file transfer to and from the IBM i IFS via SFTP.
